mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_PRODUCT ( PRODUCT_NAME, PRODUCT_TYPE, MIN_INTEREST_RATE, MAX_INTEREST_RATE, INTEREST_PAYMENT_TYPE, INTEREST_CALC_TYPE, SALE_START_DATE, SALE_END_DATE, PRODUCT_STATUS, BRANCH_JOIN_YN, INTERNET_JOIN_YN, MOBILE_JOIN_YN ) VALUES ( #{dto.product_name}, #{dto.product_type}, #{dto.min_interest_rate}, #{dto.max_interest_rate}, #{dto.interest_payment_type}, #{dto.interest_calc_type}, #{dto.sale_start_date}, #{dto.sale_end_date}, 'PENDING', #{dto.branch_join_yn}, #{dto.internet_join_yn}, #{dto.mobile_join_yn} )
mapper.select: SELECT p.product_no, p.product_name, p.product_type, p.created_at, CASE WHEN c.cnt > 0 THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS has_join_condition, CASE WHEN d.cnt > 0 THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS has_description, CASE WHEN r.cnt > 0 THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS has_interest_rate, CASE WHEN t.cnt > 0 THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS has_terms FROM tb_product p LEFT JOIN (SELECT product_no, COUNT(*) cnt FROM tb_product_condition GROUP BY product_no) c ON p.product_no = c.product_no LEFT JOIN (SELECT product_no, COUNT(*) cnt FROM tb_product_description GROUP BY product_no) d ON p.product_no = d.product_no LEFT JOIN (SELECT product_no, COUNT(*) cnt FROM tb_product_rate GROUP BY product_no) r ON p.product_no = r.product_no LEFT JOIN (SELECT product_no, COUNT(*) cnt FROM tb_product_terms GROUP BY product_no) t ON p.product_no = t.product_no WHERE p.product_status = 'PENDING' ORDER BY p.created_at DESC

SELECT p.product_no, p.product_name, p.product_type, p.min_interest_rate, p.max_interest_rate, p.interest_payment_type, p.interest_calc_type, p.sale_start_date, p.sale_end_date, p.product_status, p.branch_join_yn, p.internet_join_yn, p.mobile_join_yn, p.created_at, p.updated_at, r.rate_no, t.terms_no, d.description_no, c.condition_no FROM tb_product p LEFT JOIN (SELECT product_no, MIN(rate_no) AS rate_no FROM tb_product_rate GROUP BY product_no) r ON p.product_no = r.product_no LEFT JOIN (SELECT product_no, MIN(terms_no) AS terms_no FROM tb_product_terms GROUP BY product_no) t ON p.product_no = t.product_no LEFT JOIN (SELECT product_no, MIN(description_no) AS description_no FROM tb_product_description GROUP BY product_no) d ON p.product_no = d.product_no LEFT JOIN (SELECT product_no, MIN(condition_no) AS condition_no FROM tb_product_condition GROUP BY product_no) c ON p.product_no = c.product_no WHERE p.product_no = #{product_no}
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_product SET product_status = 'SALE', updated_at = SYSDATE WHERE product_no = #{product_no} AND product_status = 'PENDING' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM tb_product_rate WHERE product_no = #{product_no}) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM tb_product_terms WHERE product_no = #{product_no}) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM tb_product_description WHERE product_no = #{product_no}) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM tb_product_condition WHERE product_no = #{product_no})
